events.description: Quantum circuit layout is rendered, showing 4 parallel wires, multiple quantum gates (CNOT, X, Z), measurement gates, and a surrounding teal box with a quantum computer label.
events.clip_query: A quantum circuit diagram with four wires, various logic gates, and measurement symbols enclosed in a teal box.

events.description: Glowing dots begin to travel from left to right along the quantum wires, simulating signal propagation.
events.clip_query: Glowing dots moving horizontally across parallel lines in a circuit diagram.

events.description: As the glowing dots pass through the gates, the gates dynamically light up and increase their stroke width based on proximity.
events.clip_query: Circuit gates glowing brighter as a light pulse passes through them.

events.description: The glowing dots reach the measurement gates, triggering a random 4-bit binary string output to update on the right side of the circuit.
events.clip_query: A binary bitstring updating its values at the output of a quantum circuit simulation.
